title: How Far Can Volcanic Ash Travel?
description:
Ash from one eruption can cross countries, oceans and sometimes circle the planet.

Fine ash and aerosols can travel thousands of kilometres; the smallest material injected high into the atmosphere can spread globally.

Travel distance depends on particle size, eruption height and wind patterns; heavy ash falls near the volcano.

High-altitude volcanic aerosols can affect sunsets and climate far from the eruption.
